correctness.rationale: For all finite triangle-free simple G, explicitly prove induced-P3 line-graph Horn closure equals E(G[V(S)]), including empty/disconnected cases, then apply the derived Boolean-fiber Möbius identity and vertex-cover inclusion-exclusion to derive \(\mu(A,B)=(-1)^{|R|}I_{G[W]}(-1)\). Leaf recurrence and cycle transfer verify consequences. Separate standard-library enumeration checked 215512 intervals, but infinite validity rests on proof.

value.rationale: The graph-to-Horn construction is natural P3-star convexity; the theorem computes every lattice-interval Möbius value via an intrinsic induced graph, enabling signed-independence methods. The general identity is not implied by the separately known forest bound or Boolean inversion.
